### Do You Understand the Times?
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-april-12.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 12:32
Points:
- Believers need spiritual discernment rather than relying solely on human intellect to navigate difficult eras.
- Like the men of Issachar, God's people must perceive the moral climate and recognize how to respond obediently.
- Society plunges into confusion, idolatry, and moral corruption whenever it abandons God's revelation.
- Gaining true wisdom requires regular immersion in Scripture to evaluate life and culture through biblical truth.
- Discerning the times calls Christians to actively serve as preserving salt and illuminating light.
